notes.subject: צור המישור
notes.rationale: rok bilong level graun — 'the rock of the plain' — is a mocking epithet for Jerusalem; some read it as a place-name.

notes.subject: פקד / הנני אליך
notes.rationale: 'הנני אליך' is literally 'behold me unto you' — an attack formula: 'mi stap liklik long yu' / 'mi i kam long yu' — rendered as 'lukim yu'.

notes.subject: jerusalem
notes.rationale: Direct address ('lukim yu, yu i stap long-valu') — Yahwe speaks against Jerusalem personified as female dweller.

notes.subject: ⟨i⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin predicate marker supplied; Hebrew has no copula.

translation: lukim yu, yu ⟨i⟩ stap long-valu, rok bilong level graun — Yahwe i tok. Ol i tok: Husat i ken kamdaun long olgeta bilong yumi? Na husat i ken kamap insait long ol haus bilong yumi?
